title: AiNftFactory
tagline: AiNftFactory is a platform that uses AI-generated images to assist in creating NFTs. #AiNFT #NFTcreation #ArtificialIntelligence #Hackathon
description: AiNftFactory is a platform designed to assist users in creating their own NFTs by generating images using AI technology. Built on NextJS and OpenAI, this project leverages the power of machine learning to simplify the NFT creation process. The platform operates on the Scroll layer2 network, enabling users to mint NFTs that are uniquely their own. With AiNftFactory, users can easily generate high-quality images for their NFTs without needing any prior design experience. The platform is intuitive and user-friendly, providing a straightforward method for creating and issuing NFTs. Overall, AiNftFactory aims to democratize the NFT market by making it accessible to anyone, regardless of their technical background or artistic ability.
how_its_made: Our project, AiNftFactory, was built using a combination of nextjs and openai technologies. We utilized the power of openai's  DALL·E model to generate unique and personalized images for our users' NFTs. To start, we used nextjs to create a user-friendly and responsive front-end interface for our platform. One particular hacky aspect of our project was utilizing scroll, a layer2 network, to issue our users' NFTs. This allowed for faster and more cost-effective transactions compared to using a traditional blockchain. Overall, incorporating openai's technology greatly benefited our project by allowing for the creation of unique and personalized NFTs.
